g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Potato contour precedes two eye curves. Carton body precedes gable and fold; seam and junction duplicates are filtered. Colander body precedes attached handles and spaced drainage holes. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Potato, carton and colander bodies lower grey; outlines, eyes, fold and handles higher black. Carton gable and drainage holes white unraised. No calibrated-height or material claim.
